site_title: Handpano — The Buyer's Guide to Handpans
description: Independent, citation-backed reviews and resources for first-time handpan buyers. Choose the right scale, maker, and budget without affiliate bias.
tagline: Find your first handpan without the affiliate spin.

authors.name: Handpano Editorial
authors.bio: The Handpano editorial team writes independent guides for first-time buyers based on direct testing and market research.

editorial.how_we_test: We buy handpans at retail price or borrow them from owners. We never accept free instruments in exchange for reviews.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We sell our own buyer's decision guide and lessons. We do not use affiliate links, and makers do not pay us for placement.
editorial.corrections: If we make an error regarding a maker's specifications, pricing, or materials, we correct it on the page and log the date of the change.
